The '''Shipwrights' Trace''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected four of the five major [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroutes]]. It began in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], close to the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] and intersected the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] before terminating at [[Allanteen VI/Legends|Allanteen Six]] on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]].
